chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar and Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked them about the muḥrim: how should he be dealt with when he dies? They said, “His face is to be covered, and he is to be treated as one treated from among the halal, except that no perfume is to be brought near him.”

key_terms.الْحَلَالِ: one not in iḥram; in ordinary lawful state
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of iḥram

ai.seo_question: How should a muḥrim be prepared after death according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muḥrim who dies while in the state of iḥram. He is to be handled like others in funeral preparation, with the specific exception that perfume is not to be applied or brought near him.
